policy.publicCountRule: Only completed convoys with participation.status=attended and participation.confidence verified or confirmed_internal count toward public attended statistics.
policy.truckersmpAttendingRule: For Kings Logistics historical statistics, a TruckersMP VTCs Attending entry for Kings Logistics is accepted as verified evidence that Kings participated in that convoy.
policy.duplicateRule: platform + platformEventId is authoritative when available; otherwise internal id is used.
